That was what started it. Well, Handy himself, I think that your friend, Abby Niles, helped along with that little thing. What Handy did, in there he admitted he heard, for instance, what he called the Atlanta blues, which was Make Me a Pallet on the Floor or something like that. He admitted that he heard a Negro thumping it out on a guitar at a railroad station once, and he took out his pad and he put down the tune. See, he admitted that.
